activity.role: Chief of the Unelli and coalition commander
activity.notes: Caesar's Gallic War III.17 names Viridovix as chief of the Unelli and commander-in-chief of the revolted states that joined him in 56 BCE. 'Armorica' was a broad geographic-cultural region, not a centralized kingdom ruled by Viridovix, so ATLAS models the specific anti-Roman coalition rather than an 'Aremorica' state.

sources.title: Caesar, Gallic War, Book III
sources.citation_text: Caesar states that Viridovix, chief of the Unelli, held supreme command over the revolted states and their army during the 56 BCE campaign.
